title: an inline edit script naming the Vec append method is refused by the hook
body: The worker hook refuses any Bash command whose text holds the word for sending a branch upstream, even inside a heredoc of Rust code (a Vec method call trips it); make code edits with the Edit tool, not an inline script.

title: A skills file moves tests/init.rs bundle counts
body: A new file under skills/ raises the bundle count hard-coded in tests/init.rs (lines 130, 208, 387: `N files`); bump all three with it.

title: closeout events.jsonl parse flakes under load
body: `a_flaky_check_red_after_its_rerun_blocks_and_the_answer_resumes_at_the_pr` (tests/closeout.rs) went red once under the full parallel `cargo test` at the `events.jsonl` parse (`:73`, a half-written line) and passed 3/3 alone and on the next full run: rerun before chasing it.
